svg.aria-label: The system design master template drawn as a map. A client request flows down through layer one, how the request reaches you, layer two, where the work happens, and layer three, where the data lives. Caching runs beside the path on one side, the keep-it-alive components on the other, a dashed asynchronous branch carries events to the analytics layer, and the response returns to the client.

g.text: asynchronous path: no user is waiting on it

svg.text: services emit events as they work
reports read from here, never from the production database
the user's request, moving down through layers 1 to 3
the answer, returning to the client
